title: Vocabulary-gated Journey activities and lesson reinforcement
changes: Immersive lesson reinforcement is now vocabulary-led: Picture Matching is scheduled inside lessons when the lesson has suitable mnemonic scenes, rather than being treated as a separate XP-gated unlock.
Special activities such as Karuta, Conversation, Theatre, Manga and SRS Battle are treated as optional Journey side quests. SRS Battle remains separate from lesson content.
Removed XP / Adventure Point requirements from activity readiness. Activities are gated by the learner's available, relevant vocabulary instead.
The Journey timeline now carries appropriate optional side quests after lessons without making them blockers for the next required lesson.
The same activity policy is exposed to the roadmap so upcoming activities and side quests reflect vocabulary readiness rather than old XP/AP progression.
